data.one_liner: Flutter widgets and theme suite following the Yaru design language for desktop and web applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of Flutter widgets, a custom theme for Material and Yaru components, and a complete icon set designed around the Ubuntu desktop Yaru design guidelines.
use_when: You are building a desktop or web application with an Ubuntu or Yaru look and feel.
You need custom desktop-oriented widgets and icons tailored for Linux/desktop environments.
avoid_when: Your application requires a purely standard Material or Cupertino look and feel without Linux desktop styling.
You are targeting non-desktop platforms where a desktop UI kit is unnecessary.
strengths: Official Yaru theme and widget suite for Flutter.
Includes a complete custom icon set following the Yaru design language.
weaknesses: Very niche styling tailored specifically to Ubuntu's Yaru design system.
Limited to platforms supporting the underlying dependencies.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific system dependencies on Linux such as libgtk-3-dev and cmake for development setup.
